articles.summary: Kratos reported its third quarter 2026 financial results, including Revenues of $471.8 million, Operating Loss of $4.9 million, Net Loss of $0.2 million, Adjusted EBITDA of $50.9 million and a consolidated book to bill ratio of 2.2 to 1.0.
articles.title: Kratos Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

articles.summary: Kratos announced a contract from Gulf Space Technology Public Company Limited (GST) to deliver the first Q/V/Ka-band gateway antenna systems for the THAICOM 10, a software-defined high throughput satellite.
articles.title: Kratos Awarded Contract to Deliver Fully Integrated Q/V/Ka-Band Gateway and Antenna Systems for Gulf Space Technology’s Software-Defined Satellite

articles.summary: Kratos announced a long-term agreement with Seagate Space for use of the company’s initial Gateway™ offshore launch platform to support planned missions from the platform starting in 2027.
articles.title: Kratos and Seagate Space Partner to Advance Mobile Offshore Launch Capabilities for National Security Missions
